statement: 涌潮对壁滞止的精确参照取 rho g h_r：h_r/h_l = 3.4940，由 Saint-Venant 激波（Rankine-Hugoniot）条件 u_i = (h_r - h_i) sqrt(g (h_r + h_i) / (2 h_r h_i)) 在 h_i = 4 m、前缘速度 u_i = 2 sqrt(g h_l) = 12.5262 m/s 下解得 h_r = 13.9758 m；浅水闭式 4.0000 rho g h_l 是其近似上界，两者相差 14.48%。

scope.system: uniform bore stopped by a vertical wall (u_r = 0)
conditions: Saint-Venant (hydrostatic) pressure assumption, pre-reflection state (h_i, u_i)
exclusions: no air entrainment, no compressibility, no three-dimensional effect

notes: this is the anchor that makes the impact peak band falsifiable in claim 1
